cited.quote: The lumpsum amount payable under Tamil Nadu Government Servants’ Family Security Fund Scheme shall be enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/-

rationale: C2 is Finance (Pension) G.O.(Ms) No.197 dated 01.09.2021 raising the lumpsum payable on death in service of Government employees from Rs.3,00,000 to Rs.5,00,000. Matches the amounts promised. Teachers are not named separately, so slight doubt on that part.

cited.quote: Action is being taken to establish a Welfare Board for Non-Resident Tamils

rationale: C1 only reports that action is being taken to set up a Welfare Board, a plan and not a department. C4 refers to an existing Commissionerate for Non-resident Tamils. No extract shows an order creating a Non-Resident Tamils Department.

cited.quote: are exempted from payment of all compulsory, non-refundable fee (Enrolment / Registration, Tuition, Games, Union,

rationale: C5 is a general fee exemption for SC/ST candidates in medical colleges under existing orders, not a full tuition plus hostel scholarship for first generation daughters of farmers. C1 and C2 show general scholarships only. Related activity only.

cited.quote: decided to accept the recommendations of the Committee and to revise the norms for

rationale: C2 accepts an expert committee (constituted 2019) on bus condemnation norms. C1 is a 2018 committee on land acquisition, a different subject. No extract shows implementation of a 2018 committee's recommendations on the Transport Corporation's losses.

cited.quote: This scheme will be implemented during the year 2021-22, for which a sum of Rs.150.00 crore has been provided

rationale: C3 shows the existing handloom rebate subsidy scheme continuing with a budget provision, which is the same activity carrying on and not a new dedicated measure. C5 concerns MSME capital subsidy, a different subject. The promise is vague.

cited.quote: This scheme aims to skill rural youth aged between 18-35 who are poor and

rationale: C2 describes the central DDU-GKY scheme, general rural skilling with no plumber or electrician trades. C1 covers training for children in care institutions. C4 integrates skill programmes under TNSDC. Related activity, but no step for plumber or electrician training of rural youth.

cited.quote: 10,000 youth will be trained and provided with self- employment by engaging Rural Self Employment

rationale: C2 reports youth self-employment training and producer groups, and C3 livelihood parks for SHGs. None creates youth self-empowerment groups of 15 persons. Related activity only.

cited.quote: reduction of selling price of milk of all variants by Rs.3/- per litre w.e.f. 16.05.2021.
the reduction in retail price of Aavin milk by Rs.3 per litre

rationale: C2 states the selling price of all Aavin milk variants was cut by Rs.3 per litre with effect from 16.05.2021, after the government took office, and gives revised rates. C3 confirms it was one of the government's first orders. No GO is cited, so the date is the effective date.

cited.quote: to agitate against the farm laws and wish to present this before the assembly

rationale: C2 only mentions the farm laws in a dedication in the Agriculture Budget speech. C5 records an Assembly resolution on the Citizenship Amendment Act, not the farm laws. No extract shows an Assembly resolution urging repeal of the farm laws.

cited.quote: For the financial year 2021-2022 a sum of Rs.5.31 crore has been allocated for the

rationale: C1 and C2 describe existing scholarship schemes and allocations at unchanged rates (for example Rs.7,500 and Rs.8,000 per annum). C3 is a portal cost reimbursement. No extract shows an order raising the annual scholarship amounts for Adi Dravidar or Scheduled Tribe students.

cited.quote: This Common Alert Protocol disseminates, disaster early warning SMS to public through the Telecom Service

rationale: C1 and C2 describe the existing Common Alert Protocol and SEOC warnings via SMS and TV in policy notes. This is existing activity, not a new GO, scheme or programme. Directional commitment, so policy-note description of continuing activity is not started.

cited.quote: Some of the tenements constructed in the past are in dilapidated condition, posing risk to the lives

rationale: C1 and C4 describe reconstruction of dilapidated Slum Clearance Board tenements generally, allotted to earlier occupants. No extract mentions fishermen or an allotment of new houses to them. Related broader scheme only.

cited.quote: Should belong to Adi Dravidar or Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity communities.

rationale: C2 shows eligibility for the existing Special Post-Matric Scholarship limited to Adi Dravidar communities. No extract mentions extending any scholarship to children of inter-caste marriages with Adi Dravidar or Scheduled Tribe parents.

cited.quote: Considering its importance, Airports Authority of India have decided to take up expansion of Madurai Airport.

rationale: C1 and C2 cover land acquisition for Madurai airport expansion. This is not a formal step urging the Union government to declare it an international airport. No resolution, letter or GO on that issue appears.
The extracts concern committees on encroachments, building approval, audit and GOBAR-DHAN, none about forming new districts or an executive committee for it.

cited.quote: CEA has approved the scheme for an amount of Rs. 1,355.14 crore.

rationale: C1 reports Green Energy Corridor Phase II substations and a 400 kV line in Tirunelveli, Kanyakumari and Tiruppur sent for approval, with CEA approval obtained and Union approval pending, plus Ottapidaram works. This is a step on transmission lines in some listed districts, but not yet operational and only partly matches the promise.

cited.quote: has requested the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India in the Memorandum presented on 17.06.2021

rationale: C1 records the Chief Minister's Memorandum to the Prime Minister on 17.06.2021 seeking restoration of India's sovereignty over Katchatheevu, a formal advocacy step on the same issue. C2 only states intent. Directional promise, so this dedicated step suffices.

cited.quote: Livelihood Parks as common Infrastructure centres for Self Help Groups to pursue their livelihood activities

rationale: C1 sets up livelihood parks as common infrastructure for SHGs, a different object and not run by unemployed graduates and ITI holders carrying out village infrastructure work. C3 to C5 are general SHG notes and awards. Related activity only.

cited.quote: effective initiatives towards protection/ maintenance of Water bodies and other Government lands
Administrative Sanction to take up 115 water bodies at an outlay of Rs.71.89 crore

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.64 of 08.02.2022 forming state, district and divisional committees for protection and maintenance of water bodies, a dedicated order. C5, a 23 February 2022 GO, sanctions repair and restoration of 115 water bodies. First dedicated order is C1. Scope of C1 is mainly encroachments.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction to take up 115 water bodies at an outlay of Rs.71.89 crore under Phase VI
Hence, it is imperative to rejuvenate all water bodies in the rural areas in a holistic manner.

rationale: C4 is a GO dated 2022-02-23 sanctioning Rs.71.89 crore for repair, renovation and restoration of 115 water bodies across regions. C2 (08.03.2022) allots up to 30% of AGAMT-II funds to rejuvenating rural water bodies. C4 is the earliest funded order.
